description: Generates 32 cryptographically random bytes using RAND_bytes() from OpenSSL, Base64-encodes using EVP_EncodeBlock(), persists the encoded key to /tmp/.master.key as JSON object with exact format {"aes_key":"<base64>"} (no whitespace) and file permissions set to 0600. Returns the 32-byte key as const uint8_t*.
name: init_session
